cycle_report.main_failure_clusters: Previous screens had no edits; all candidates exhausted B16 on initial roots. Repeated full-history writes consumed unnecessary pilot CPU.
cycle_report.deep_bottleneck_abstraction: Evaluation budget allocation erased the scorer action being evaluated. Persistence cost grew with retained evidence size.
cycle_report.why_previous_improvement_attempts_were_i: Changing scorers cannot earn meaningful selection credit when no screen invokes their causal parent-selection stage; saving more evidence can prevent completing the loop.
cycle_report.proposed_intervention: Cap combined initial roots atB/2 and bank roots atB/4, retain fresh enumeration; archive immutable searches/generations once and atomically commit a small live manifest.
cycle_report.expected_mechanism_of_improvement: Expose descendant selection during B16 and amortize repeated persistence while preserving exact proof/counter/provenance values.
cycle_report.verification_plan: Paired frozen-state screens; replay every stored candidate/scorer/proof and genealogy; exact serializer roundtrip; interruption and atomic-commit fault injection; per-call CPU debit and late-result rejection.
cycle_report.regression_risks: Proof-ID prefix can indefinitely exclude later bank records. Early success or structural/compiler caps can stop reserved edits. Journal cache relies on immutable completed records and single-writer use; initial archive and reconstruction may be slower.
cycle_report.result_after_testing: 27 targeted tests pass;686 candidates and231 descendant edges replay exactly. All six proposals change actual descendant sequences, but verified success and top-two ranking remain unchanged. Real partial checkpoint reconstructs exact values/order.
cycle_report.keep_revert_revise_decision: Keep causal screening implementation and lossless journal under documented conditions; reject capability/generalization/RSI claims from this diagnostic. Revise search/candidate generation next using unchanged frozen verifiers.
cycle_report.updated_rule_for_future_improvement_cycl: An evaluation must exercise the intervention’s downstream action within its real budget; evidence-preservation overhead and interruption losses must be measured explicitly.
